Severity S2 not S1 because the boot itself completes on 1.21.11+ (only the transformation is missing) and a workaround exists; the 1.21.10 server crash is graded separately (ECA-004). Owner may raise to S1 if CF is the primary distribution. Not a regression of the migration: the _cf boot check postdates the layer's gate records. Sources: REVIEW.md neoforge-1.21.10 rows L24 (changed src/cf/.../EcaTransformationService.java) and L285 (stub); https://github.com/jivinstev/EpicCoreAPI/issues/47 (Next step 8); https://github.com/jivinstev/EpicCoreAPI/issues/47#issuecomment-6228226503; scratchpad eca-branches-results.md (FINAL RESULTS: shipped _cf FAIL on 1.21.10..26.3) DESIGN (CF spike, 2026-10-17, proven on FML 10/11/12 = 1.21.10, 1.21.11, 26.3): FML 10+ finds a ClassProcessorProvider only in a jar of FMLModType LIBRARY on the launch layer, not in a mod jar. Fix: split the _cf transformer (EcaTransformationService and its ClassProcessorProvider service file) into its own small jar with manifest FMLModType: LIBRARY, nested in the _cf jar as jar-in-jar (META-INF/jarjar); the _cf mod jar is otherwise unchanged; 1.21.3-1.21.8 (FML 4-9) keep the current route. Gate: a shipped-expect-cf.txt line for the container-replacement log line, booted by the shipped-jar gate's --variant cf. Estimate 6-9 agent-hours.

issues.notes: 2026-10-21 round (plan #63). build.gradle's archiveFileName/archivesName and gradle.properties' mod_version are the authors' (1.21.1-only) and are carried to every version branch; checked against the releases: no port release from eca-1.1.9-mc1.21.3 (2026-10-17) to eca-1.1.9-fix-mc26.3 ever had the Minecraft version in the jar name (now epic-core-api-1.1.9-fix_mr.jar on every version), so this is not a regression of this round's head cascade. 1.21.1 (the authors' only version) is not affected. Visibility rare: only someone keeping jars of several versions in one place meets the clash. Workaround: the release tag names the version. Fix: add the Minecraft version to archiveFileName on the version branches (or a per-branch mod_version suffix).

issues.notes: 2026-10-25, found by MMVU playtests (real client, released jars, every installed version). 1.21.1-1.21.8 log 'Loaded 2 BossShow definition(s) from mod data' and '... from JSON'; 1.21.10, 1.21.11, 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3 log only 'Loaded 1 BossShow definition(s) from JSON' and never 'from mod data'. A dependent mod's range-triggered boss show (the_last_sword's queen) then never starts, so the boss never activates and refuses all damage: the fight and the quest step after it cannot be done (the playtest matrix: 7 of 7 queen runs on these versions). Suspected cause: the 1.21.10 port replaced FML's removed modFile.findResource with findModResource(), a walk over modFile.getContents().getContentRoots() that finds nothing inside a jar, and its catch-all returns null without a log, so loadModDataDefinitions() silently loads nothing. Fix: list the jar's data/<modid>/bossshow and data/<modid>/eca/bossshow through the 1.21.10+ FML content API (or the server ResourceManager's listResources), and log a failure instead of swallowing it. Verify with the playtest's queen steps on 1.21.10..26.3.
issues.title: Boss shows in mod data never load on 1.21.10 and later: a mod's bosses never start their show (and never wake)

issues.notes: 2026-10-25, found by MMVU playtests. CAUSE: Minecraft 1.21.5 made ListTag.getString(int) return Optional<String> (javap on the 1.21.10..26.3 clients: 'public java.util.Optional<java.lang.String> getString(int)'). BossShowHistory still does pidStr.equals(uuids.getString(i)) and cid.equals(seen.getString(i)) (4 places: hasSeen and markSeen, both modes), which compiles but compares a String with an Optional: always false. So hasSeen never returns true, and markSeen appends a duplicate each time. A show with allow_repeat true and a range trigger (the_last_sword's queen: effect_radius 4) restarts whenever the range scan finds the player inside it again: the boss's activation lines arrive in chat, the cinematic (letterbox, first subtitle) is back within about a second, and melee hits do nothing while it runs. Intermittent because it is a race with that scan: 1.21.8 every queen fight (4 of 4), 1.21.5 3 of 5; 1.21.1 and 1.21.4 never (5 of 5 each: getString returns String there). Not a game freeze: the client keeps running. 1.21.10..26.3 cannot show it yet (ECA-039 stops their shows loading) but carry the same code. With allow_repeat false, the same bug replays a once-only show to the same player every time. FIX: compare against the value, e.g. uuids.getString(i).orElse("") or uuids.getStringOr(i, "") on 1.21.5+ (the 1.21.1/1.21.4 text is right as it is). Verify with the TLS playtests' queen steps on 1.21.5 and 1.21.8.
issues.title: 1.21.5 and later: a player who has seen a boss show is never recorded as having seen it, so a repeatable show restarts while they stay in range and the boss cannot be fought

issues.notes: Found by the 2026-10-26 fix round (plan #75). enableSelfAttach stores the low byte of Boolean.TRUE's compressed pointer into a one-byte boolean, so self-attach fails ('Can not attach to current VM') whenever that byte is 0x00, which depends on the JVM's command line (about 1 in 8). Also the cause of the intermittent shipped-jar gate failure. Fixed at 1.21.10 with putBoolean (47ee440); 1.21.1-1.21.8 still carry the author's code. Fix: take 47ee440's one-line change at 1.21.1 and cascade. Reconcile 2026-10-29 (keep-current/2026-10-29, merge 26bba65 of authors abf7670): decision keep ours at 1.21.1 (fixed@7ca21b8 unchanged). Evidence: the authors' 1.1.9-fix-fix (56da255, abf7670) touches none of 7ca21b8 (src/main/.../agent/AgentLoader.java): fix-ledger worksheet 'the authors changed 0 of them', and git diff 4979c6f..26bba65 over that file is empty; the incoming change is extension-render buffer pooling, the loading-screen switch and the transformer whitelist, none on this defect's path. No A/B (keep needs none).
